about: Smoke cases for the narration pipeline (NarrationMarkdown / NarrationHTML / NarrationPlain → NarrationPlanner). Run: .build/debug/ReadAloud --test-narration Tests/narration/smoke.json [--verbose]. The fuller suite is Tests/narration/cases.json.
